timeline.text: Welcome to Starting a New Job and Feeling Out of Place. I will guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you will hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let us begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I want to belong here, but I feel out of place.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: Everyone else seems to know what they are doing.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I am worried people can see my uncertainty.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep comparing my beginning to their experience.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels tense and overly alert.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I feel pressure to prove myself quickly.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me is afraid I made the wrong choice.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that being new feels vulnerable.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I am carrying more pressure than this moment requires.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that is completely okay. Keep breathing, and we will continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I am allowed to be new here.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I do not need to know everything on day one.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: Questions are part of learning, not proof of failure.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can let other people's experience guide me.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can soften as I find my rhythm.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can focus on learning instead of performing.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Uncertainty does not mean I do not belong.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can notice one thing that is becoming familiar.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can give myself time to settle in.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You do not need the feeling to disappear. See if there is simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I bring value even while I am learning.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: I can build confidence through small experiences.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I trust myself to ask thoughtful questions.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can connect with one person at a time.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can feel grounded in this new place.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I do not have to earn belonging through perfection.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I am capable of growing into this role.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can meet today without mastering the whole job.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I am ready to take my place here.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
